characters.name: LIISA
characters.description: Väike inimene, tüdruk. Blondid juuksed, suured sinised silmad. Kannab roosat kleiti ja valgeid sandaale. Naeratav ja sõbralik rõõmsameelne näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: PEETER
characters.description: Väike inimene, poiss. Pruunid juuksed, rohelised silmad. Kannab sinist T-särki, lühikesi beeže pükse ja valgeid tosse. Naeratav ja rõõmsameelne uudishimulik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: KÖÖK
locations.description: Cozy kitchen with light yellow walls, a light wooden floor, and a single window on the back wall showing green trees outside. A simple white kitchen counter with a sink on the left. A small round wooden table is in the center. Bright, warm lighting from the window. Cartoon style.

locations.name: AED
locations.description: Sunny green garden with lush green grass. A small, colorful picnic blanket spread on the grass under a leafy tree. Bright blue sky with a few white clouds. Flowers blooming in the background. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Liisa and Peeter stand in a cozy kitchen. Liisa is a small girl with blonde hair, wearing a pink dress. Peeter is a small boy with brown hair, wearing a blue t-shirt and shorts. They both look curious and happy, standing near a small round wooden table in the center of the kitchen. The kitchen has light yellow walls, a light wooden floor, and a single window on the back wall showing green trees outside. A simple white kitchen counter is on the left. Bright, warm lighting from the window. Cartoon style.

Liisa and Peeter are standing in the same cozy kitchen, looking at each other with bright, excited smiles. They are both gesturing slightly with their hands as if sharing an idea. The small round wooden table is still in the center. The kitchen environment is exactly the same: light yellow walls, light wooden floor, window showing green trees, and white kitchen counter. Bright, warm lighting from the window. Cartoon style.

Liisa and Peeter are standing by the simple white kitchen counter in the same cozy kitchen. Liisa is reaching for a red apple in a fruit bowl, while Peeter is holding a yellow banana. Other colorful fruits like grapes and oranges are in the bowl on the counter. They look focused and happy. The kitchen environment is exactly the same: light yellow walls, light wooden floor, window showing green trees, small round wooden table in the background. Bright, warm lighting from the window. Cartoon style.

Liisa and Peeter are standing at the kitchen sink on the simple white kitchen counter in the same cozy kitchen. Liisa holds a red apple under a gentle stream of water, and Peeter is carefully washing a yellow banana. A few other fruits are in a colander next to the sink. They are focused on their task. The kitchen environment is exactly the same. Bright, warm lighting from the window. Cartoon style.

Liisa and Peeter are sitting at the small round wooden table in the same cozy kitchen. Liisa carefully uses a child-safe knife to cut a banana into slices on a small cutting board. Peeter holds a bunch of grapes, ready to add them. A large empty mixing bowl is on the table. The kitchen environment is exactly the same. Bright, warm lighting from the window. Cartoon style.

Liisa and Peeter are sitting at the small round wooden table in the same cozy kitchen. Liisa holds a wooden spoon and gently stirs a colorful fruit salad in a large mixing bowl. Peeter watches her with a happy smile. The bowl contains various cut fruits. The kitchen environment is exactly the same. Bright, warm lighting from the window. Cartoon style.

Liisa and Peeter are standing next to the small round wooden table in the same cozy kitchen. The large mixing bowl, now full of the brightly colored fruit salad, is on the table. Both children are smiling proudly at their finished work. The kitchen environment is exactly the same. Bright, warm lighting from the window. Cartoon style.

Liisa and Peeter are outside in a sunny green garden. Liisa carefully carries the large mixing bowl filled with colorful fruit salad. Peeter is walking beside her, holding a small picnic blanket. They are walking towards a leafy tree. The garden has lush green grass and flowers blooming in the background. Bright blue sky with a few white clouds. Cartoon style.

Liisa and Peeter are having a picnic in the sunny green garden. They are sitting on a colorful picnic blanket spread under a leafy tree. The large bowl of fruit salad is between them, and they are both eating from small bowls with spoons. They look happy and content. The garden has lush green grass and flowers blooming in the background. Bright blue sky with a few white clouds. Cartoon style.

Liisa and Peeter are still sitting on the colorful picnic blanket under the leafy tree in the sunny green garden. The fruit salad bowl is mostly empty, and they are both smiling broadly, looking very happy and satisfied after their picnic. The garden has lush green grass and flowers blooming in the background. Bright blue sky with a few white clouds. Cartoon style.
